sloka: महाबलानां रुदतां कुर्वतामुदकं पितु: ।विज्ञाय तुमुलं शब्दं त्रस्ता भरतसैनिका: ॥ २.१०२.३४॥
transliteration: mahābalānāṁ rudatāṁ kurvatāmudakaṁ pitu: ।vijñāya tumulaṁ śabdaṁ trastā bharatasainikā: ॥ 2.102.34॥

translations.english: The soldiers of Bharata were alarmed on hearing the tumultuous sounds raised by those mighty brothers offering libations of water and lamenting.
